AlmaLinux Media & Entertainment SIG Works On Database

Community hardware reports — privacy-first, no hostnames or serials collected.

14 Reports 9 Unique GPUs 2 Platforms Submit your rig → 01 — Run One command Runs locally on your AlmaLinux workstation. Collects hardware info, writes a JSON file, and copies it to your clipboard automatically. bash <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KernelChief/almalinux-me-hardware-catalog/main/scripts/almalinux-me-hardware-survey-reporter.sh) 02 — Submit Paste & go The script opens the GitHub issue form automatically. Paste the JSON from your clipboard and hit submit — that's all. Open form → 03 — Published You're in Your report is validated automatically and appears in this database within a minute, searchable by everyone.
